name: Bidhan Chandra Roy
contribution: Bidhan Chandra Roy was a physician and Congress leader who became chief minister of West Bengal in the post-Partition period.
context: His public work unfolded as Bengal was divided and West Bengal faced refugee rehabilitation, administrative reorganization, and the pressures of early Indian state-building.
impact: Roy's role helps connect Partition's map-making to the practical governance and humanitarian burdens that followed in West Bengal.
